adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the importer now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)` using `t[:link]` from the Disqus export. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` immediately does `open(url).read` with no scheme/host allowlist or validation. Although `TopicEmbed.import` later rejects non-`http(s)` URLs, that check occurs *after* the `open(url)` has already been performed, so a crafted `<link>` could trigger unintended fetches (e.g., SSRF or non-HTTP URIs depending on Ruby/open-uri behavior).
